text.p: - The Slovenian parliament will elect a new parliamentary president in Monday's session.
- A Delo opinion poll showed that current Prime Minister Janez Drnovsek was the most popular Slovenian politician in November followed by President Milan Kucan.

- Slovenia's only port Luka Koper expects over 100,000 new cars to go through it this year, almost double last year. That makes Koper one of most important European ports for unloading imported cars, Luka's marketing manager said.
- The biggest party in November general elections, the centre-left Liberal Democrats, said it will not propose a candidate to be president of the new parliament.
- Soccer team Primorje, from the southwestern city of Ajdovscina, came first in the autumn stage of the first division. The competition will resume on March 2, 1997.
- Slovenian president Milan Kucan and Foreign Minister Davorin Kracun will participate in the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) summit in Lisbon, which starts on Monday.
